data.explanation: The Bußgeldstelle (fine office) of Landkreis Musteruckermark is fining you €232.00 for running a red light and has recorded 1 point in the driving register (Fahreignungsregister). The letter was officially delivered to you today. You may decide whether to accept the fine or file a written objection (Einspruch) if you disagree — the app will show until when you can do this. If you do nothing, the notice becomes final and the full amount becomes payable two weeks after that; the app will show the payment due date once it is known. Consider seeking legal advice if you plan to contest it.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the fine
items.action: If you disagree with the fine, submit a written objection (Einspruch) to the Bußgeldstelle, in writing or recorded in person, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the fine notice becomes legally final (rechtskräftig) and the fine, fee and delivery costs must be paid.

items.action: Once the notice becomes final (if you do not object), pay the total amount of €232.00 to the Bußgeldstelle's account; the app will show the exact due date.

data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle (fine office) of Landkreis Musteruckermark issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid, Az. VB-26-501882) against Ronny Musterspree for running a red light on 17 October 2026 at Stettiner Straße, Musterprenzlau. The total amount is €232.00 (fine €200.00, fee €28.50, delivery costs €3.50) plus 1 point in the driving register, and the letter was officially delivered on 24 November 2026.
